basic_profile.bio: I'm a 42-year-old father of two boys living in the Midwest. By day, I work as a software engineer specializing in front-end development. I've always had a passion for coding and started my career right after finishing my Computer Science degree. My interests range from parenting and pet care (I'm an avid cockatiel enthusiast) to exploring conspiracy theories for fun. I value a balanced life, so I dedicate evenings to family time and weekends to DIY projects around the house. I'm happily married to my college sweetheart, and we enjoy movie nights and camping trips with our kids. I'm typically online during my lunch break and later in the evening after the kids are in bed.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science, having completed a Bachelor's degree in the field. Over the years, I've honed my skills through continuous self-learning and professional experience in software development. In addition, my curiosity about animal behavior has led me to delve deep into pet care, particularly for birds, and I often share insights with fellow cockatiel owners.
